response.sql:
SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute
FROM scans AS sc
JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
  AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.riskeval;

assumptions.assumption: A scan with spanmin = 0 is excluded because its file-size-per-minute value is undefined; the schema does not specify whether zero-duration scans are possible.
